details.problem: The developer onboarding process was crippled by a fragile legacy architecture and manual environment setup, taking up to four weeks for a single new developer to become productive.
details.solution: I orchestrated the entire development environment using Docker and Docker Compose, creating a fully isolated, one-command setup. I also integrated a Redis caching layer for high-throughput API endpoints and optimized MongoDB connection pooling to resolve critical timeouts.

impact.text: Reduction in new developer onboarding time
Reduction in database query load via Redis caching
